Sambenedettese and Erreà do more than create football shirts. 26 Aug 2026 # "Raised on sand, hardened by the sea": introducing Sambenedettese's 2026/27 away kit There is an ivory that is never simply a colour. It is the shade of sand shaped by the Adriatic wind, the very sand on which San Benedetto del Tronto learned resilience long before football. That is where Erreà's new Away shirt begins: moving away from the Home kit's red and navy to tell the story of the city from a different perspective, its coastline.   The ivory base reflects the light of the beach and the deep bond between San Benedetto and the sea. The blue collar, back-neck insert and cuffs finished with fine gold stripes reinforce this narrative, evoking the town's maritime tradition and the colours of its coastline. ImageImage Inside the collar, the phrase "Raised on sand, hardened by the sea." completes the story. More than a slogan, it is a statement of identity: the second chapter of a journey that began with the Home shirt and will continue with the next kit in the collection.   Sambenedettese and Erreà do more than create football shirts.
